configurationFields.label: Message of the Day
configurationFields.description: Sets the message of the day that is shown in the in-game server list.

configurationFields.label: Level Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the level (world) to load, or create if it does not exist.

configurationFields.label: Level Seed
configurationFields.description: Sets the seed to randomise the generation of a new world. Empty = random seed.

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time.

configurationFields.label: Enable Java Edition
configurationFields.description: Whether support for Java Edition clients is enabled.

configurationFields.label: Enable Bedrock Edition
configurationFields.description: Whether support for Bedrock Edition clients is enabled.

configurationFields.label: Use Favicon
configurationFields.description: Whether to use a server favicon or not.

configurationFields.label: Favicon Path
configurationFields.description: The path to the server's favicon.

configurationFields.label: Default Game Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the game mode for new players.

configurationFields.label: Force Game Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will send game mode values to clients other than the one saved during world creation.

configurationFields.label: Difficulty Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level of the world.

configurationFields.label: Enable Hardcore Mode
configurationFields.description: Whether the server is in hardcore mode.

configurationFields.label: Default Player Permission Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the permission level for new players joining the server for the first time.

configurationFields.label: OP Permission Level
configurationFields.description: The permission level assigned by the /op command.

configurationFields.label: Enable PVP
configurationFields.description: Whether PVP is enabled or not.

configurationFields.label: Protect Creative
configurationFields.description: Whether to protect players in creative against PVP.

configurationFields.label: PVP Knockback
configurationFields.description: Whether attacks should have knockback or not.

configurationFields.label: PVP Swing
configurationFields.description: Whether players should swing when attacking or not.

configurationFields.label: PVP Hurt Animation
configurationFields.description: Whether to show red hurt animation and FOV bobbing.

configurationFields.label: Allow Commands From Console
configurationFields.description: Whether commands from the console are accepted or not.

configurationFields.label: Chat Format
configurationFields.description: Format for chat messages.

configurationFields.label: Allow Chat Reports
configurationFields.description: Allow players to report chat messages.

configurationFields.label: Enable April Fools Mode
configurationFields.description: Enable April Fools features.

configurationFields.label: View Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowed view distance. Higher values have performance impact.

configurationFields.label: Simulation Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the distance from any player that the world will be ticked. Higher values have performance impact.

configurationFields.label: Allow Nether
configurationFields.description: Whether the Nether dimension is enabled.

configurationFields.label: Allow The End
configurationFields.description: Whether the End dimension is enabled.

configurationFields.label: World Lighting Engine
configurationFields.description: The lighting engine to use.

configurationFields.label: World Chunk Type
configurationFields.description: The chunk storage format.

configurationFields.label: Write Chunks In Place
configurationFields.description: Whether to write chunk data directly to region files.

configurationFields.label: Target TPS
configurationFields.description: The server's target tick rate.

configurationFields.label: World Autosave Ticks
configurationFields.description: Interval in ticks to autosave the world (0 to disable).

configurationFields.label: World Compression Algorithm
configurationFields.description: Compression algorithm for world chunks.

configurationFields.label: World Compression Level
configurationFields.description: Compression level for world chunks.

configurationFields.label: Java: Enable Packet Compression
configurationFields.description: Whether packet compression is enabled.

configurationFields.label: Java: Compression Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the smallest size of raw network payload to compress.

configurationFields.label: Java: Packet Compression Level
configurationFields.description: Compression level (0 to disable).

configurationFields.label: Bedrock: Enable Packet Compression
configurationFields.description: Whether packet compression is enabled.

configurationFields.label: Bedrock: Compression Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the smallest size of raw network payload to compress.

configurationFields.label: Bedrock: Packet Compression Level
configurationFields.description: Compression level (0 to disable).

configurationFields.label: Save Player Data
configurationFields.description: Whether to save player data to disk.

configurationFields.label: Player Data Save Interval
configurationFields.description: Interval to save player data.

configurationFields.label: Send Recipes
configurationFields.description: Whether to send recipe book data to players. Disabling this can significantly improve login performance.

configurationFields.label: Enable Proxy Support
configurationFields.description: Enables support for proxies.

configurationFields.label: Enable Velocity
configurationFields.description: Whether Velocity support is enabled or not.

configurationFields.label: Velocity Secret
configurationFields.description: The secret as configured in Velocity.

configurationFields.label: Enable BungeeCord
configurationFields.description: Whether BungeeCord support is enabled or not.

configurationFields.label: Enable Query
configurationFields.description: Whether to listen for Query protocol requests or not.

configurationFields.label: RCON aktivieren
configurationFields.description: Whether the Remote Console RCON protocol is enabled.

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: The password to use for RCON authentication.

configurationFields.label: RCON Max Connections
configurationFields.description: The maximum number of RCON connections allowed.

configurationFields.label: LAN Broadcast
configurationFields.description: WARNING: READ THIS BEFORE ENABLING THIS SETTING! This setting enables local network discovery for Java clients. This may require manual port allocation (see LAN Broadcast Port).

configurationFields.label: LAN Broadcast Port
configurationFields.description: Set to 0 for a random port (default). WARNING: In some cases, the default behavior will fail. You MUST set a static port here and map it in the Network and Ports setting for the instance.

configurationFields.label: Enable Online Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, all connected players must be authenticated.

configurationFields.label: Enable Allow List
configurationFields.description: If set, all connected players must be listed in the server whitelist.

configurationFields.label: Enforce Allow List
configurationFields.description: Kick players not on the whitelist.

configurationFields.label: Authentication
configurationFields.description: Whether authentication is enabled or not.

configurationFields.label: Enable Encryption
configurationFields.description: Whether packet encryption is enabled.

configurationFields.label: Prevent Proxy Connections
configurationFields.description: Whether to block proxy connections.

configurationFields.label: Auth Prevent Proxy URL
configurationFields.description: The URL to authenticate with if prevent_proxy_connections is enabled.

configurationFields.label: Auth URL
configurationFields.description: The URL to authenticate with.

configurationFields.label: Auth Connect Timeout
configurationFields.description: Timeout for auth connection.

configurationFields.label: Auth Read Timeout
configurationFields.description: Timeout for auth reading.

configurationFields.label: Allow Banned Players
configurationFields.description: Allow players flagged by Mojang.

configurationFields.label: Auth Allowed Actions
configurationFields.description: Actions allowed if allow_banned_players is enabled. Must follow the exact format: ['FORCED_NAME_CHANGE', 'USING_BANNED_SKIN']

configurationFields.label: Enable Texture Filtering
configurationFields.description: Whether to filter/validate player textures.

configurationFields.label: Auth Allowed URL Schemes
configurationFields.description: Allowed URL schemes for textures. Must follow the exact format: ['http', 'https']

configurationFields.label: Auth Allowed URL Domains
configurationFields.description: Allowed URL domains for textures. Must follow the exact format: ['.minecraft.net', '.mojang.com']

configurationFields.label: IP Scrubbing
configurationFields.description: Whether to scrub players' IP addresses from logs.

configurationFields.label: Blocked Plugin Permissions
configurationFields.description: A list of permissions to block from plugins. Must follow the exact format: ['permission.node', 'another.node']

configurationFields.label: Java: Require Texture Packs
configurationFields.description: If set, clients must use resource packs in the current world.

configurationFields.label: Java: Resource Pack URL
configurationFields.description: The direct download URL to the resource pack.

configurationFields.label: Java: Resource Pack SHA1
configurationFields.description: The SHA1 hash of the resource pack.

configurationFields.label: Java: Resource Pack Prompt
configurationFields.description: The message to show to the user when prompted.

configurationFields.label: Java: Force Resource Pack
configurationFields.description: Whether to force the client to download the resource pack.

configurationFields.label: Bedrock: Require Texture Packs
configurationFields.description: If set, clients must use resource packs in the current world.

configurationFields.label: Bedrock: Force Resource Pack
configurationFields.description: Whether to force the client to download the resource pack.

configurationFields.label: Bedrock: Resource Packs
configurationFields.description: The Bedrock resource packs to include. Must follow the exact array format: ['pack1', 'pack2']

configurationFields.label: Use Skin Textures
configurationFields.description: Whether to use player skins or not.

configurationFields.label: Use Cape Textures
configurationFields.description: Whether to use player capes or not.

configurationFields.label: Use Elytra Textures
configurationFields.description: Whether to use player elytras or not.

configurationFields.label: Enable Logging
configurationFields.description: Whether logging is enabled or not.

configurationFields.label: Logging Threads
configurationFields.description: Whether to print threads in the logging message.

configurationFields.label: Logging Timestamp
configurationFields.description: Whether to print the timestamp in the message.

configurationFields.label: Log File
configurationFields.description: Name of the log file.

configurationFields.label: Logging Level
configurationFields.description: The log verbosity level.

configurationFields.label: Use Environment Log Level
configurationFields.description: Whether to allow choosing the log level by setting the RUST_LOG environment variable.

configurationFields.label: Log Console Commands
configurationFields.description: Whether commands from players should be logged in the console or not.

configurationFields.label: Log RCON Success
configurationFields.description: Whether successful logins should be logged to console.

configurationFields.label: Log RCON Wrong Password
configurationFields.description: Whether wrong password attempts should be logged.

configurationFields.label: Log RCON Commands
configurationFields.description: Whether to log commands run from RCON.

configurationFields.label: Log RCON Quit
configurationFields.description: Whether RCON client quit should be logged.

configurationFields.label: Enable Server Links
configurationFields.description: Enable custom server links.

configurationFields.label: Bug Report Link
configurationFields.description: Link for bug reports.

configurationFields.label: Support Link
configurationFields.description: Link for support.

configurationFields.label: Status Link
configurationFields.description: Link for server status.

configurationFields.label: Feedback Link
configurationFields.description: Link for feedback.

configurationFields.label: Community Link
configurationFields.description: Link for community.

configurationFields.label: Website Link
configurationFields.description: Link for website.

configurationFields.label: Forums Link
configurationFields.description: Link for forums.

configurationFields.label: News Link
configurationFields.description: Link for news.

configurationFields.label: Announcements Link
configurationFields.description: Link for announcements.

configurationFields.label: Discord Link
configurationFields.description: The URL for the Discord link.

deploymentSteps.name: Download Config File
deploymentSteps.source:
java_edition = true
java_edition_address = "0.0.0.0:25565"
bedrock_edition = true
bedrock_edition_address = "0.0.0.0:19132"
seed = ""
max_players = 1000
view_distance = 16
simulation_distance = 10
default_difficulty = "Normal"
op_permission_level = 4
allow_nether = true
allow_end = true
hardcore = false
online_mode = true
encryption = true
motd = "A blazingly fast Pumpkin server!"
tps = 20.0
default_gamemode = "Survival"
force_gamemode = false
scrub_ips = true
use_favicon = true
favicon_path = "icon.png"
default_level_name = "world"
allow_chat_reports = false
white_list = false
enforce_whitelist = false

[logging]
enabled = true
level = "Info"
env = true
threads = true
color = false
timestamp = true
file = "latest.log"

[resource_pack.java]
enabled = false
url = ""
sha1 = ""
prompt_message = ""
force = false

[resource_pack.bedrock]
enabled = false
force = false
packs = []

[world]
lighting = "default"
autosave_ticks = 0

[world.chunk]
type = "anvil"
linear_version = "V1"
write_in_place = false

[world.chunk.compression]
algorithm = "LZ4"
level = 6

[networking.authentication]
enabled = true
connect_timeout = 5000
read_timeout = 5000
prevent_proxy_connections = false
auth_url = ""
prevent_proxy_connection_auth_url = ""

[networking.authentication.player_profile]
allow_banned_players = false
allowed_actions = ['FORCED_NAME_CHANGE', 'USING_BANNED_SKIN']

[networking.authentication.textures]
enabled = true
allowed_url_schemes = ['http', 'https']
allowed_url_domains = ['.minecraft.net', '.mojang.com']

[networking.authentication.textures.types]
skin = true
cape = true
elytra = true

[networking.query]
enabled = false
address = "0.0.0.0:25565"

[networking.rcon]
enabled = false
address = "0.0.0.0:25575"
password = ""
max_connections = 10

[networking.rcon.logging]
logged_successfully = true
wrong_password = true
commands = true
quit = true

[networking.proxy]
enabled = false

[networking.proxy.velocity]
enabled = false
secret = ""

[networking.proxy.bungeecord]
enabled = false

[networking.java_compression]
enabled = true
threshold = 256
level = 4

[networking.bedrock_compression]
enabled = true
threshold = 256
level = 4

[networking.lan_broadcast]
enabled = false
port = 0

[commands]
use_console = true
use_tty = false
log_console = true
default_op_level = 0

[chat]
format = "<{DISPLAYNAME}> {MESSAGE}"

[pvp]
enabled = true
hurt_animation = true
protect_creative = true
knockback = true
swing = true

[server_links]
enabled = true
bug_report = "https://github.com/Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin/issues"
support = ""
status = ""
feedback = ""
community = ""
website = ""
forums = ""
news = ""
announcements = ""

[server_links.custom]
Discord = "https://discord.gg/pumpkin"

[player_data]
save_player_data = true
save_player_cron_interval = 300

[fun]
april_fools = false

[recipe]
send_recipes = true

[plugins]
blocked_permissions = []
